srm.strength_factor_note: factor < 1 strengthens the material; factor > 1 reduces c and tan(phi)

parallel.disabled_reason: adaptive bracket lookahead requires srm.parallel.enabled=true, strategy=lookahead, preserve_decision_order=true, and max_workers>1

thread_control.apply_note: threadpoolctl applies this limit around parallel SRM trials when available; otherwise environment variables are scoped around the prefetch window and restored

parallel.worker_limit_policy: batch/CLI SRM uses CPU and optional memory budget to raise worker count; GUI/interactive SRM keeps a low cap unless srm.parallel overrides it
parallel.speculative_cancellation_note: adaptive lookahead can skip or cancel not-yet-started speculative trials when a cancel token is provided; running solver trials still finish their current safe section
